reason: A sourceNamespace may aggregate multiple unrelated studies. Structural eligibility must not be created by pooling focal taxa and site-years across unrelated underlying programmes.

normalization.doi: trim, lowercase, remove leading https://doi.org/, http://doi.org/, doi:
normalization.citation: trim and collapse internal whitespace only; do not fuzzy-match distinct citations

within_programme_gate.site_year_definition: exact valid decimalLatitude x decimalLongitude x four-digit event year
within_programme_gate.repeated_focal_definition: same sourceTaxonSpeciesName in at least two distinct valid site-year strata

namespace_semantic_candidate_rule: A v0.4 qualifying sourceNamespace remains eligible for source-method adjudication only if at least one provenance-resolved programme block independently passes all within-programme structural thresholds.
independent_count_rule: For the >=12 gate, a sourceNamespace contributes at most one unit even if multiple internal programme blocks pass; v0.5.1 mirror/provenance deduplication can only reduce this further.
next_if_below_12: Stop the primary joint interaction arm before semantic-method adjudication because fewer than 12 independent namespaces can satisfy the frozen joint support criteria at the correct programme grain.
next_if_at_least_12: Proceed to the already-frozen source-semantic and effort adjudication only for namespaces with at least one within-programme PASS block.
